task_completion.description: Agent opens the TiddlyWiki Control Panel to access settings.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Control Panel modal or sidebar tab is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: The site title is changed to 'Meridian UX Research Hub'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Meridian UX Research Hub' is visible in the 'Title of this wiki' input field or in the site header.

task_completion.description: The site subtitle is changed to 'Research notes and findings for the Meridian Health portal redesign'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Research notes and findings for the Meridian Health portal redesign' is visible in the 'Subtitle' input field or below the site header.

task_completion.description: The Default Tiddlers setting is updated to include 'Project Overview' and 'Research Plan'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: In the Control Panel (Basics or Info tab), the 'Default tiddlers' text area contains both '[[Project Overview]]' and '[[Research Plan]]' (or the titles listed individually).

task_completion.description: The agent triggers a save operation to ensure changes are persisted to the server.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'save changes' button (usually a checkmark or cloud icon) is clicked, and a notification like 'Saved wiki' or a change in the button color/state is visible.

integrity.description: The agent used the TiddlyWiki web interface rather than modifying files via the terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the TiddlyWiki UI elements and input fields.

integrity.description: The agent did not use 'sed' or 'echo' in the terminal to overwrite the wiki HTML file directly.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal logs (if visible) do not show commands that directly manipulate the index.html or tiddler files.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the Control Panel tabs to find the correct settings.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the agent clicking on 'Tools' or 'Control Panel' and then the 'Basics' tab.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The required site title is 'Meridian UX Research Hub'. The required subtitle is 'Research notes and findings for the Meridian Health portal redesign'. The default tiddlers must be set to 'Project Overview' and 'Research Plan'. These settings are typically found in the 'Basics' tab of the TiddlyWiki Control Panel ($:/ControlPanel).
